name: printing-press-instagram-cli
description: Agent-native social CLI harness, starting with Instagram.

scripts.smoke: node src/cli.mjs --help && node src/cli.mjs profile list --json && node src/cli.mjs post instagram --profile smoke --text "hello" --media test/fixtures/sample.jpg --dry-run --json && node src/cli.mjs comment instagram --profile smoke --url https://www.instagram.com/p/test/ --text "nice" --dry-run --json && node src/cli.mjs dm instagram --profile smoke --to testuser --text "hello" --dry-run --json
